q: Montréal bagels are boiled in water mixed with what?
funFact: That honey water is why they taste slightly sweet.

q: What kind of oven bakes a real Montréal bagel?
funFact: The wood fire at St-Viateur burns 24 hours a day.

q: How many ecosystems live inside the Montréal Biodôme?
funFact: You can walk from a rainforest to icy waters in minutes.

q: The Biodôme building was built for the 1976 Olympics. For which sport?
funFact: It was a velodrome — a track with steep banked curves.

q: Which Biodôme animal is famous for moving very slowly?
funFact: Sloths are so slow that algae grows on their fur.

q: How many legs does every insect have?
funFact: Count them at the Insectarium — always six.

q: How many legs does a spider have?
funFact: Eight legs means a spider is not an insect at all.

q: Butterflies can taste with which body part?
funFact: A butterfly lands on a leaf to find out how it tastes.

funFact: Poutine was invented in Québec in the 1950s.
